description:
Give every writer and component one stable description of Jido.

Exit criteria:
- One approved category describes Jido.
- Agent, AgentServer, Action, Signal, Directive, runtime, and ecosystem have stable definitions.
- Operational control is a primary benefit with lifecycle, capability, traceability, and failure-response pillars.
- Identity, authorization, audit, observability, governance, security, and compliance have explicit claim boundaries.
- Claims have clear proof requirements.
- Canonical specs agree with each other.

Backlog tasks: 45

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md
title: E02 — Set the positioning and vocabulary canon
